281459746.description: This kit includes a collection of geodes and other rocks stored in a resealable plastic bag along with a cloth bag labeled 'Break Open Geodes.' The set also includes a booklet providing information about geodes. The rocks are intended for educational or hobbyist purposes, allowing users to break them open and explore their crystal interiors.

282121731.description:
This is a half of an agate geode with one flat polished face. The face shows blue and gray banding around a small cavity lined with tiny sparkling crystals. The back and sides are rough, with a brown and gray stone exterior with yellow tan patches. It can be displayed as a desk or shelf accent, or kept as a mineral specimen.

Condition: Pre-owned, no visible damage. The back is naturally rough, and the polished face has a few small surface marks and mineral specks.

281501452.description: This is a natural raw mineral specimen featuring realgar transitioning into orpiment on a grayish-black host stone. The specimen measures 2x1.5x1 inches and weighs 47.7 grams. It includes vivid orange-red crystalline growths with a small white crystal inclusion on one edge. The piece is uncut and unpolished, displaying a rough, irregular shape with sharp angular edges and a jagged fracture surface. Color variations range from deep red to bright orange and earthy gray-brown. Suitable for geological collectors or educational display.
